decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Development shall not take place until full details of the position of the proposed automatic ticket vending machines (for the refurbished ticket hall hereby permitted) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - Development shall not take place until full details of the position of proposed bicycle stands hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - Development shall not take place until full details of the design, tonal contrast, position, location and height of all new directional signs have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Renewal of permission 00248/N/P17 for improvements to Gunnersbury station, incorporating the station concourse and ticket hall, platform access stairs, platform shelters and furniture lighting and security dated 04.11.04.
